clips.title: The story
paras: Xavian is an ancient ruined night elf temple complex in northeastern Ashenvale, now overrun and claimed by the satyrs. Serving as the primary seat of satyr influence in the forest, the ruin is foul with demonic corruption and dark rites directed against the woodland.

Tucked away in the northeastern hills of Ashenvale, west of Forest Song and north of Satyrnaar, Xavian stands as the foremost bastion of satyr power in the region. Once a sacred elven temple, its stone arches and terraces have been desecrated by followers of the Burning Legion. Leaders among the satyrs, including Prince Raze and Geltharis, oversee their kin from these ruins. They perform defiling rituals across the grounds, even utilizing stolen Warsong oil to further blight the sacred woodland. The area takes its name from Xavius, the highborne councilor who became the first satyr during the War of the Ancients after failing Sargeras.
